MOBILITY STUDIES
Lincoln Highway Improvement
Cicero Avenue to Chicago Road
Cook County
January 10, 1972
Mr. Charles N. Rellis
Assistant Superintendent
Board of Education
District No. 170, Cook County
16th and Aberdeen Streets
Chicago Heights, Illinois 60411
Dear Mr. Rellis:
This is to acknowledge receipt of your letter of January 6, 1972, relative to the subject highway improvement and in particular the right-of-way acquisition on the Roosevelt School site.
In as much as you have listed specific questions in your letter, I will answer each below in the order that you have listed them:
1. A part of our preliminary study was the determination of an approximate right-of-way costs. This estimate was prapared "in-house" and listed the Roosevelt School taking at $1.75 per square foot. It should be pointed out that the official appraisal will be done by independent appraisors and may not reflect the above mentioned price.
A for the Lincoln Highway Improvement is 8790. The additional 3695 square feet noted in this scheme is required for the proposed cul-de-sac and would become the property of the City of Chicago Heights. It is suggested that in the final settlement, payment should be made to the City on a square foot basis for the land turned over to the school board minus the school board land turned over to the City.
